items.title: Ensure direct REVIEW story creation cannot leave review metadata missing
items.context: Reproduce from external project: story_create --phase=REVIEW succeeds, then review_run_start fails because currentReviewRound is absent. Either initialize the same review-round fields as story_advance into REVIEW or block direct REVIEW creation with a precise validation error; prefer the smallest behavior-compatible fix.

happy.desc: story_create --phase=REVIEW creates a Story with an ISO currentReviewRound, and review_run_start immediately returns a Review run ... started message for a supported reviewer lane.

edge.desc: story_create --phase=REVIEW also allows review_loop_start to use the initialized currentReviewRound instead of failing with missing metadata.

adversarial.desc: A legacy/corrupt REVIEW Story that is manually missing currentReviewRound still fails closed, but the error identifies the half-initialized REVIEW state and points to repair or recreate guidance.

items.userSees: review_run_start shows Review run B-xxxx:RR-001 started immediately after story_create --phase=REVIEW, and review_loop_start no longer reports missing currentReviewRound for the new story.
